concept.title: Mini Harbour
concept.source_prompt: A tiny harbour on a dusk island: talk to the keeper, find the lantern core, light the beacon.
concept.player_fantasy: The traveller who brings the light back.

actions.value: The beacon is dark. Find Keeper Maren.
The core hums in your pack.

nodes.speaker: keeper_maren
nodes.text: The beacon on the hill is dark. Bring it a lantern core, would you?

nodes.speaker: keeper_maren
nodes.text: Look near the old arch. Ember will follow you.

nodes.speaker: keeper_maren
nodes.text: The light is back. Thank you, traveller.
